item.title: Zyphra Releases ZONOS3-Mini: Open-Source TTS With 100M Active Parameters
item.description:
Zyphra released ZONOS3-Mini, an Apache 2.0 text-to-speech model with 800M total and 100M active parameters. It clones voices, steers delivery word by word and runs in real time in the browser

The post Zyphra Releases ZONOS3-Mini: Open-Source TTS With 100M Active Parameters appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2: Same Model, Different Safeguards
item.description:
Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, one model with two safeguard levels. Fable 5.2 scores 49.1% on FrontierCode 2.0, costs $8/$40 per million tokens, and ships with a 1M-token context window.

The post Anthropic Launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2: Same Model, Different Safeguards appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Meta Releases Muse Ember, a 1M-Context Model for High-Volume Agent Work
item.description:
Meta Muse Ember is Meta’s smallest model, built for tool calls, coding subtasks and document parsing. It ties Claude Haiku 5.5 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at roughly a third of the cost per task.

The post Meta Releases Muse Ember, a 1M-Context Model for High-Volume Agent Work appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Google Unveils TPU 8i Max and TPU 8tx: A Dual-Chip TPU and a Confidential TPU
item.description:
Google added TPU 8i Max and TPU 8tx to its eighth-generation TPU lineup. TPU 8i Max packs 2 TPU 8i chips per package for long-context agents. TPU 8tx adds hardware confidential inference. Bloomberg reports 2027 availability.

The post Google Unveils TPU 8i Max and TPU 8tx: A Dual-Chip TPU and a Confidential TPU appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Baidu’s ERNIE Evolve Automated Research System Beats NanoChat and NanoGPT Records
item.description:
Baidu’s ERNIE Evolve is an automated research system that edits code, runs experiments and keeps only verified gains. It beat public bests on NanoChat and NanoGPT Speedrun and sped up ERNIE-5.5-Flash inference.

item.title: Reason Machines Open-Sources Aspen, a Git Server Built for AI Agents
item.description:
Reason Machines has open-sourced Aspen, a self-hosted Git server for AI agents. It follows OpenAI’s Pando design and sustained 567 pushes per second on one 8-core server in the company’s own test.

The post Reason Machines Open-Sources Aspen, a Git Server Built for AI Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: 0sec Labs Open-Sources 0, an AI Security Harness With Web UI, CLI and MCP
item.description:
0sec Labs has open-sourced 0, an AI security harness for code review, pentesting, reverse engineering and fixes. It runs locally through a browser console, a headless CLI and an MCP server, with your own model provider.

item.description:
